text:
tess (PM): Dropped a micro-prototype for a very compact composer aimed at embedded consoles. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/redwood/compact-micro-gesture (see 'micro badge' frames). Goal: keep controls discoverable but reduce visual weight.

maria (Design): Love the space savings. Two quick issues: micro token badge reads noisy at small sizes and the action cluster feels like one control when squeezed. Thinking a thin divider chip and slightly more breathing room.

sam (Eng): Implementation POV: exact tokenization per stream chunk is heavy. Propose visual shows an approximate marker "≈42" (or "est. 42") during streaming and swap to exact when generation completes. Cheap estimator: max(1, ceil(char_count/4)). Server returns final count. We'll add a telemetry flag when estimator is used.

jia (DevEx): Accessibility: visual "≈42" is fine, but screen readers should get "approximately 42 tokens". Use aria-label on the badge and a hidden live region with role="status" and aria-atomic="true" for periodic updates. Throttle announcements to ~300ms. Also add aria-describedby linking the badge to the live region so context is clear.

maria (Design): Copy: users conflate "Stop" with throwing away the response. Research suggests "Interrupt" communicates the right affordance. For micro state we should go icon-only + tooltip "Interrupt (Esc)"; for SR use aria-label="Interrupt generation". I'll add both variants in fig.

sam (Eng): Keyboard + mobile notes: Esc interrupts, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter regenerates. On mobile, long-press the streaming bubble to surface actions (Interrupt / Regenerate). Show a one-time hint toast "Long-press to interrupt or regenerate responses".

jia (DevEx): VoiceOver detail: avoid announcing the approximate symbol. On the DOM keep visual text "≈42" but aria-label="approximately 42 tokens". Live region final message: "Generation complete — final token count: 42". Throttle voice updates and set aria-atomic=true to ensure consistent announcements.

maria (Design): Color passes: swapped to slate-900 on white for badge text which meets 4.5:1. Added a 1px subtle divider between badge and action cluster in the prototype so they don't read as one control.

sam (Eng): When user triggers regenerate mid-stream we'll start a new request and crossfade outputs to avoid jank; KV cache preserved unless explicitly cleared. I'll add the estimator and hotkey bindings in a small PR.

tess (PM): Nice. Action items: maria — add micro variants (icon-only + labeled); sam/jia — PR with estimator, aria snippets, keyboard handlers, and mobile long-press hint. I'll schedule a 10m follow-up tomorrow after preview testing.

preview-bot: Preview deployed: https://preview.redwood.dev/compact-micro-gesture/1719992222 — please test keyboard, screen reader and long-press flows.

jia (DevEx): Quick PR checklist I'll include:
- Visual shows approximate marker during stream (≈N) and exact on completion
- Badge aria-label reads "approximately N tokens" during stream; final aria announcement on completion
- Hidden live region with role=status & aria-atomic=true, updates throttled to 300ms
- Esc = Interrupt, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter = Regenerate
- Long-press action on mobile + one-time hint toast

tess (PM): Target to land PR tomorrow. Thanks team :thumbsup:
